g.title: j376312010
g.text: i don't know why this shit scares me so much

g.title: j2397120464
g.text: it's not like i'm not used to this kind of nonsense already, if... not to this extent

g.title: j3816426398
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j3988914556
g.text: Hey, Flare.

g.title: j1927185461
g.text: sorry if i'm a bit melancholy. i woke up this morning feeling a way i haven't felt in a while

g.title: j1553852157
g.text: hey.

g.title: j672478331
g.text: i don't know if it's the grief of the band's deaths or... this whole issue with *her* or what...

g.title: j324177621
g.text: Check boolean FlareLizzieEnemy

g.title: j299729778
g.text: About Lizzie... I think I might have *really* pissed her off. :|

g.title: j324177621->j299729778
g.text: true

g.title: j3113598376
g.text: Eh, we've all been through a lot. You're in good company.

g.title: j324177621->j3113598376
g.text: false

g.title: j3055737053
g.text: I think you have a right to be a bit messed up right now.

g.title: j324177621->j3055737053
g.text: false

g.title: j2981780028
g.text: I'm here to listen, if you want to talk.

g.title: j324177621->j2981780028

g.title: j3450122157
g.text: trust me... i know

g.title: j4190256461
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2403144741
g.text: i suppose. but who doesn't?

g.title: j3059875415
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2410238249
g.text: she hasn't stopped screaming at me since

g.title: j3997218895
g.text: heh. what a motley crew we make...

g.title: j3147751274
g.text: although i suppose most of the others aren't contending with a soul-eating infested horror yammering at them at all hours

g.title: j2445790704
g.text: thanks

g.title: j1787793236
g.text: when i woke up today, i felt that same... dread i haven't felt since i was a youth

g.title: j3024946913
g.text: that would actually be a decent band name, now that i think about it

g.title: j1515046493
g.text: not the kind of "oh, great, i'm going to die today" kind of dread that she brings

g.title: j976886030
g.text: i digress

g.title: j3552442127
g.text: or even the kind of shit you're used to dealing with on a daily basis. so it sounds a little trite to even whine about

g.title: j3495005846
g.text: but... i don't even know if this'll resonate with you...

g.title: j3872390239
g.text: but sometimes i wake up and i just don't know who the world expects me to be anymore...

g.title: j3438395153
g.text: whatever i am isn't good enough. whatever i am can't check the boxes

g.title: j636479822
g.text: constantly fed images and standards of what i'm *supposed* to be, every day of my life, everywhere i go

g.title: j2159246690
g.text: the other day i saw this gym bunny walk down the street

g.title: j473675714
g.text: absolute perfect specimen in impeccable clothes and a tight vest. you could have bounced a golden groat off that ass and gotten back two silvers and a bronzie

g.title: j747486879
g.text: every inch of them dripping in class. status. confidence. money. their wristwatch probably cost more than what i'd make in a year

g.title: j3051688542
g.text: sol above i wanted them so badly. wanted to BE them so badly...

g.title: j2246602182
g.text: that's what i mean

g.title: j583387576
g.text: "look like this" "act like this" "feel like this" "BE THIS" or you are WORTHLESS

g.title: j2311862366
g.text: trying to be what they want feels so wrong. and even if it didn't? it'd be pointless... i know i'll fail... but not trying? ... lua, the loneliness feels like a crushing weight that makes it so it's hard to get out of bed some days

g.title: j925515143
g.text: sorry...

g.title: j3522196540
g.text: this is probably all nonsense to you

g.title: j1759126386
g.text: i mean, look at us - look at *me,* darling - we couldn't be more different...

g.title: j2284813631
g.text: Not really, no.

g.title: j932935462
g.text: I can empathize, but I don't really relate...

g.title: j533581291
g.text: I think... for one reason or another, we've all felt that way in our lives, to different extremes.

g.title: j2619053953
g.text: No. It makes perfect sense to me. Trust me.

g.title: j243464348
g.text: that's fair

g.title: j3398674226
g.text: it's all right. glad for you, honestly

g.title: j3734822889
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3930255131
g.text: have to go, talk soon

g.title: j940260128
g.text: Check boolean FlarePeace6

g.title: j3278994801
g.text: maybe i make more sense to you than i thought, then

g.title: j3968996345
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j65237033
g.text: You have a new family now, in the other protoframes here. You have a place where you can be who you want to be.

g.text: true

g.title: j2535669576
g.text: Strangely, I wonder if Lizzie isn't trying to... help you feel like you belong.

g.text: true

g.text: You don't have to feel lonely anymore.

g.title: j3110885639
g.text: Trying to "consume" your consciousness so you don't feel lonely anymore.

g.title: j4134854063->j65237033
g.text: true

g.title: j3937344821
g.text: Remember what I said about the Infestation and Warframes? About how it only pulls from what is already a part of you?

g.text: true

g.text: that's a real sweet thought, but... family isn't the same as feeling like you belong in your own *self*

g.title: j530989890
g.text: Making you part of one cosmic whole.

g.title: j213567793->j65237033
g.text: true

g.title: j213567793->j65237033

g.title: j3442945889
g.text: You're in a crowded mall surrounded by people. There's no reason to feel lonely. You can make friends.

g.title: j213567793->j3442945889
g.text: true

g.title: j213567793->j3442945889

g.title: j3618674994
g.text: not to say that i haven't come around to appreciate this pack of walking science projects gone wrong

g.title: j3477111571
g.text: fear you might've missed the point...

g.title: j277983533
g.text: Adopt a kavat?

g.title: j1934338879
g.text: Well, hey, if Lizzie eats your consciousness and you join a hive mind, you won't be alone anymore, right?

g.title: j3357897741
g.text: Have you considered that... maybe that's what Lizzie is trying to do? To help you feel like you belong?

g.title: j3993018953
g.text: is that what i've really wanted this entire time?

g.title: j39666733
g.text: but that's fine. i should've expected that

g.title: j3691555488
g.text: to be a part of the stars?

g.title: j2994516942
g.text: right

g.title: j2159103044
g.text: I'm standing behind that joke, it was funny.

g.title: j508386141
g.text: Sorry. Sorry. Bad joke. Arthur keeps warning me about dark humor at the wrong time.

g.title: j539016451
g.text: i used to think all musicians wanted to die at the peak of their fame before they had a chance to burn out

g.title: j3231063887
g.text: sure

g.title: j2757748373
g.text: Centuries of being alone getting executed leaves you to having a broken "snark valve" as Aoi calls it since that was the only weapon I had to fight with.

g.title: j4294845572
g.text: thought that was my destiny in some weird way. shit, was i wrong.

g.title: j2417902798
g.text: So, I don't really know how to turn it off when -

g.title: j2215975126
g.text: but... i think i've always yearned to be a part of something bigger, and i've certainly always felt like i didn't quite belong. you're telling me that's what she's tapping into?

g.title: j983568920
g.text: stop typing

g.title: j3370063752
g.text: I think so. In the scariest possible way, yeah.

g.title: j2117937102
g.text: She's part you. She can feel that pain. That yearning. I think she's trying to *fix it.*

g.title: j1985367807
g.text: hilariously, you might be unintentionally on to something...

g.title: j2394740982
g.text: i... don't know how to feel about that, except... overwhelmed

g.title: j1675565770
g.text: Boolean FlarePeace7 is now true.

g.text: i'm going to go jot some lyrics down, and... consider what you've just said...
